fixture: Fixed centre delivery, Easy physics, deterministic RNG .5, input offsets relative to bounce, 180ms press, 10ms sampling. Drive is a legacy eventual-upfield metric, NOT a direct straight drive; directStraight means the initial velocity is within 30 degrees of the upfield axis (a reporting convention, not a gameplay rule). initialVelocity is measured after bat skill response, and subsequentContacts lists later rebounds. Drive = first bat contact moving in attacking direction >100 deg/s and ball reaches z<1. Durations are sampled spans, not human success rates.
